{{Quote|Weesa going for a swim, okie-day?|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Lake Paonga''' was a [[lake]] on the edge of [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> lying east of [[Otoh Sancture]],<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> that served as the entrance to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

The [[Paonga Strait]] connected Otoh Gunga to the Gungan [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Sacred Place]],<ref name="PfBtS">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref> at the foot of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

The lake was known to be rich in [[Gooberfish/Legends|gooberfish]].
